svg.text: Corruption robustness in UTKFace age prediction
Author-reported R² at severity 5 • higher is better • negative values are valid
Color scale: red = negative, white = 0, blue = positive (fixed −4 to 1); gold outline = oracle
B SSA relative to strongest non-oracle comparator by condition
Bars are descriptive differences of rounded aggregates; no uncertainty or significance is implied.
